title: Text the owner about each new order
summary: When your online shop sends a new order, text the owner the order number, customer and total.
description: Gives your online shop or order form a signed web address. Each order it sends (order number, customer name and total in naira) is texted to the owner straight away, and an order sent twice is only texted once. The owner's phone number is the tenant variable owner_phone.

variables.name: owner_phone
variables.why: The owner's phone number in international format without +.

params.name: path
params.title: Web address path
params.description: The path your shop calls, e.g. /orders/new.

params.name: sms_connection
params.title: Termii connection
params.description: The name of your Termii connection.

definition.name: Text the owner about each new order

steps.name: Text the owner about the order

input.sms: ='New order ' + trigger.body.order_id + ' from ' + trigger.body.customer_name + ': NGN ' + string(trigger.body.total_naira)
